st.t: Talk to Pirate Pete north east of the Ectofuntus.
s: Of course, I fear no demon!
I've decided to help you for free.

st.t: Finish talking to Captain Braindeath after the cutscene, with 1 free inventory space for the blindweed seed he gives you.
Leave the brewery by the south stairs and go south past the zombie swabs to the south-eastern farming patch, the only one you can use. If a swab attacks, long-press it and choose Intimidate.
Rake the blindweed patch.
Plant the seed in the blindweed patch.
Wait 5 minutes for the blindweed to grow.
Pick the blindweed on Braindeath Island.
Take the blindweed back to Captain Braindeath.
Climb the ladder in the south-east corner of the big room to the top floor, then put the blindweed into the hopper in the north-west corner.
Talk to Captain Braindeath.

Leave the brewery by the south stairs and go out through the fence. Head north-west to 50% Luke, go through the small gate behind him, and go up the volcano to the north. Fill your bucket with the stagnant water there.
Take the water back to the hopper on the top floor.
Talk to Captain Braindeath.
Fish 5 sluglings or karamthulu from around the coast of the island.
Add the sea creatures to the pressure barrel on the top floor.
Pull the pressure lever.
Talk to Captain Braindeath.
Talk to Davey in the room with the bunk beds, south-west of Captain Braindeath. You need at least 47 Prayer points available or he won't bless the wrench. It doesn't use them up.
Use the holy wrench on the brewing control. Be prepared to fight an evil spirit.
Kill the Evil Spirit.
Talk to Captain Braindeath.
Climb down the ladder in the north-west corner of the brewery, near Captain Braindeath, and kill a fever spider in the basement. If you're not wearing slayer gloves they'll afflict you with disease.
Pick up the fever spider body.
Add the spider body to the hopper on the top floor.
Talk to Captain Braindeath.
Fill a bucket from the output tap in the south west of the brewery.
Bring the unsanitary swill to Captain Donnie south of the Brewery.
Talk to Captain Braindeath to finish.
